headline: Webster sets the pace across the SLIAC
dek: Webster won thirteen of its matches across all competitions, drawing one and losing three, while scoring 67 goals and conceding twenty. Its attack alone outscored Principia, Lyon, MUW, Blackburn, and Eureka combined.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The distribution breaks into a sharp cliff rather than a steady slope: Greenville alone scored 35 goals, more than Lyon, MUW, Blackburn, and Eureka combined.

wire.line: Against non-conference opponents, member programs won eleven matches, drew three, and lost 36, conceding 165 goals while scoring 44.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three early-season matches remain past their scheduled dates with no published result: Principia against Health Sciences and Pharmacy, Central Methodist against Westminster (Mo.), and East Central Community against Lyon.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Webster forward Malaya Blakely scored 21 goals and added eight assists on 90 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Webster midfielder Mia Smith recorded fifteen assists alongside twelve goals on 50 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Principia goalkeeper Isabella Brancati made 108 saves while allowing 36 goals across the season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Spalding spread its 46 goals across at least thirteen different scorers while conceding seventeen goals all season.

last_match.line: Webster entered the match unbeaten since September after finishing conference play without a defeat.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
